name: ThreeJS Loader Collada
description:
ThreeJS Loader Collada loads a textured Elf Girl character from a Collada file and turns her slowly on the spot for a clean, close-up look.

How it works. The demo hands a .dae file to three.js's ColladaLoader, which parses the XML-based COLLADA interchange format — geometry, materials and its separate JPEG textures for body, face and hair — and assembles the finished scene. A LoadingManager waits until every asset…
